the hypothesis of local scale symmetry leads to a new class of non-local field theories, and that these field theories provide a new class of exact solutions to statistical systems displaying strongly anisotropic equilibrium or dynamical scaling.

the hypothesis of local scale transformations leads to exact predictions for two-point functions in systems displaying a strongly anomalous scaling, and that these exact predictions are explicitly confirmed in the ANNN model and the kinetic Ising and spherical models.

the hypothesis of local scale transformations is a powerful tool for the description of strongly anisotropic and/or dynamical scaling behaviour.

the hypothesis of local scale symmetry provides an exact description for the scaling behaviour of static and dynamical systems with a strongly anisotropy or a dynamical scaling behaviour.
